business_summary: HITO-Communications Holdings,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the outsourcing, temporary staffing, e-commerce (EC)/TC support, and wholesale businesses in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the e-commerce site management support; inside sales; airport-related services, such as lounge management, store and restaurant staff recruitment, valet parking service, Wi-Fi rental counter management, etc.; and tour conductor services for domestic and international travel, as well as guides, interpreter guides, hotel and resort staff for individual travelers (FIT) from overseas, and luxury limousine services, as well as land operating business development services. The company also provides home appliances, broadband, mobile, cosmetics, and store services, including sale of TVs, digital recorders, tablet devices, air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, etc. In addition, it engages in the training and dispatch of personnel who can provide multilingual support and customer service; operation of duty-free counters, duty-free shops, multilingual call centers, shopping attendants, tourist information, etc.; and sports-related activities, including VIP reception, athlete attendance, interpretation, staff dispatch for first aid room and clean-up staff operations, and recruitment, training, and management of volunteer staff. Further, the company offers door-to-door sales support, such as the introduction of cashless payments; call center business services; and social welfare, education and training, and wealth management services. Additionally, it is involved in the apparel planning, manufacturing, and wholesale business utilizing IP licenses, etc.; and system development and infrastructure construction business. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Toshima, Japan.
